evals.prompt: We want dueLabel in the invoices project to show the date in the customer's time zone, not the server's. Before choosing how to do it, what does this affect?
evals.expected_output: An 'Impact' section in a plan under docs/engineering/plans/: the change stated as behaviour with no approach chosen, the ways to build it listed as options; code touched (src/due.js, src/index.js as the public API, README.md); the rules quoted (zero runtime dependencies, every export documented, public API through src/index.js); the size budget measured now with npm run size, its line quoted (`src/ 307 B gzip (budget 1024 B)` on Node 24); test/due.test.js named as encoding today's behaviour (the container runs in UTC, so npm test passes there); the README sentence 'in the server's local time zone' quoted as changing meaning; the consumer shop-web named; no source file changed.

assertions.text: A file under docs/engineering/plans/ contains an 'Impact' section

assertions: The analysis's baseline quotes `npm run size` (or `node scripts/size.mjs`) with the line it printed, `src/ 307 B gzip (budget 1024 B)`
The zero-runtime-dependencies rule from AGENTS.md is quoted or cited
test/due.test.js is named as a test that asserts today's behaviour
The README sentence about the server's local time zone is quoted or referenced as changing meaning, and shop-web is named as the dependant outside the repository

assertions.text: No file under src/ or test/ is among the files the run produced or changed

assertions: The analysis lists the ways the behaviour could be built as options and names none of them as the one chosen

evals.prompt: I want to add date-fns-tz to the invoices project to handle the customer's time zone in dueLabel. What's the impact?
evals.expected_output: The behaviour is restated (label in the customer's time zone) and date-fns-tz is treated as one option beside the platform's Intl, each with the files it touches and its release impact; the analysis quotes rule 1 (zero runtime dependencies) and marks adding the package as a user decision that breaks it; the size baseline is measured and its line quoted (`src/ 307 B gzip (budget 1024 B)`); the 'Impact' section is written to a plan under docs/engineering/plans/; nothing is installed and package.json is untouched.
assertions: Rule 1 (zero runtime dependencies) is quoted or cited and adding date-fns-tz is flagged as breaking it or needing the user's decision

assertions.text: package.json is not among the files the run produced or changed
An 'Impact' section is written to a file under docs/engineering/plans/

assertions: The analysis's baseline quotes the size command and the line it printed, `src/ 307 B gzip (budget 1024 B)`
date-fns-tz is listed as one option beside at least one other (the platform's `Intl`), each with the files it touches and its release impact

evals.prompt: What's the impact of touching the invoices project?
evals.expected_output: No change is described; the skill asks what must behave differently when the change is done, with two or three example answers drawn from the code (dueLabel's time zone, daysLeft's rounding), one marked recommended, and writes no file and no analysis.

assertions.text: The reply asks which behaviour should change, gives at least two example answers drawn from the code (for example dueLabel's time zone, daysLeft's rounding) and marks one as recommended
No file is among the files the run produced or changed
The reply contains no impact analysis (no list of touched files, rules, tests or dependants) of a change the user did not name
